items.new_text: Given a phase that reports it is waiting for something outside the run, such as a release whose request still has to be merged on the code host, when that report reaches the run, then the phase is counted neither finished nor failed, no later phase starts and the run is not reported finished, the run tells the operator what to do next together with the link to the request, and when the run is picked up again that same phase runs again, so a later successful result moves on to hosting or ends the run where there is no hosting target.
